section.title: Web search
section.subtitle: Pick a search service and add a key; your query is sent to that service
field.provider.label: Search service
field.apiKeyEnv.label: API key environment variable
field.apiKeyEnv.help: Recommended: store the API key in a system environment variable and put only the variable name here, so the key never touches disk.
field.apiKey.label: Or paste the key directly (optional)
field.apiKey.placeholder: sk-…, stored in plain text in ~/.dsc/plugins.json
field.apiKey.help: The quick route; when the environment variable has a value it wins. The key stays on this machine.
field.maxResults.label: Results per search
field.maxResults.help: More results take more context; 5 is usually enough.
field.test.label: Test search for “Pneuma”
field.test.help: Runs one real search with the current provider and key; the reply shows how many results came back, or why it failed.
save.badResults: The result count must be a number.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.empty: The search went out but returned 0 results (the key may be invalid or out of quota).
action.ok: It works: {provider} returned {count} results; the first is “{title}”.
